title: AI Food and Drink Videos With a Fresh Pour | AIVideosUGC
description: Turn one bottle or can photo into a vertical pour video with ice and fizz. Use 9:16 for TikTok and Reels, with clips of 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds.
h1: AI Food and Drink Videos From a Bottle Photo
lead: Pick a serving scene and add one bottle or can photo, so the pour, the fizz, or the sip is the clip.
steps_h2: Make a Beverage Product Video in 3 Steps
steps_lead: One package photo, a short line about the serve, then a file you can post.

steps.d: Show the full bottle or can, with the cap and drink color visible. Keep the package easy to recognize.
Name the glass and one action, such as a pour or a sip. Then pick a size and a length.
Download the file and add flavor or allergen lines in your editor. Keep health claims off the clip.

faq.q: What is a food and drink video template?
faq.a: A ready serving scene for a pour, a cold glass, or a first sip. You add a photo of your bottle or can, and the clip shows that serve.

faq.q: How do I make the pour clip?
faq.a: Upload the package, name the glass and one action, pick a size and a length, then download the file.

faq.q: Why start from a photo instead of a kitchen shoot?
faq.a: The serve is built from the package photo you already have. You do not book a kitchen, a creator, or a reshoot.
Drink sellers who need a pour, a cold glass, or a sip for a feed, a listing, or an ad.

faq.q: Can I do this on the first try?
faq.a: Start with a sharp photo of the full package and name one action, such as a pour or a sip. Check that the package stays recognizable before you post.
A sharp photo of the full bottle or can, with the shape, the cap, and the visible label area clear.

faq.q: Can the clip show ice, fizz, or a sip?
faq.a: Yes. A cold scene can include ice, bubbles, or condensation. Keep the package visible beside the glass. A sip is a serving moment, not a health claim.

faq.q: Which size and length can I pick?
faq.a: Start at 9:16 for a feed, or pick 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4. A square cut can sit in a gallery. Use 6 seconds for one pour, or 10, 15, or 30 seconds when the sip needs longer. The credit cost is shown before the job runs.
24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15 and 120 for 30. A failed job returns those credits. Plans start at $24.50 a month.

faq.q: Where do flavor and allergen lines go?
faq.a: Add approved flavor, ingredient, allergen, and price text in your editor or on the listing after download. The download has no AIVideosUGC watermark and can run in your ads. A person on screen is an AI performer, not a customer.

steps.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and preserve its shape, color and visible label area exactly. A hand pours citrus soda from the silver can into one ice-filled tumbler. Frame at counter height, then make a slow push-in as the glass fills. Bright window light stays visible beside the can. End with the can and full tumbler in frame. Sound: crisp fizz and a soft pour. No music.
